svg.text: WHOM A MONSTER HITS: DS:325B, FOUR SIDES, TWO HALVES EACH (PARTY FACING UP THE PAGE)
Small numbers: member index (0 and 1 front rank, 2 and 3 middle, 4 and 5 rear). Large numbers: the order searched. The first member that is present,
above -10 hp and, if invisible, passes a 1d20 < 5 test is hit; if none qualifies the monster's attack does nothing.
